rawContent: I added a video to a @YouTube playlist https://t.co/tebHXe7tRO Ronan Farrow on #MeToo, Going to College at Eleven, and His Path to

I'd like to see a discussion of #MeToo begin to deal with the generalized problem of systemic abuse and structural impunity for violators of law in a broader context. Sexual violence is one part of a spectrum of misusing people and then having the wheels of power enable impunity.

@nakiata_ #MeToo is about abusiveness that has created victims by predators. This photo of a serene Bennett and Asia is proof of nothing. To attempt to suggest that this photo shows predatory abuse is to misunderstand the problem of preying on vulnerable people.

@AutumnOnVenus Venus - what is so culpable about Asia, from this document? I do not see anything other than compassion, and to twist this into "rape" and trying to create a derogatory view of #MeToo on this basis - is the real twisting of facts.
@CNN Where is evidence of "rape" in this picture? #MeToo

@CIssyvoo @jonlovett @RonanFarrow Excellent message, Charlotte.
....The #MeToo movement is being slagged over the Asia Argento/Jimmy Bennett flap. Asia never asked for a gag, so I tend to believe there was no intent to assault. We have to guard against vindictiveness.
@aliceinglen @jonlovett @RonanFarrow Good message....now we have to defend #MeToo and #TimesUp  against vindictive conflators who want to discredit @asiargento - she should be listened to.

@NotMedicgoddess @Riffian_ @DrakeTwgdadrea1 @NBCNews 1) Asia and Jimmy knew each other for years, and appeared to have an authentic social relationship. To suggest that one has to "know better, [and never be in any kind of intimate situation with anyone under the age majority]" is not really the point of the anti-rape laws. #MeToo

@SmartKehan @nakiata_ The #Metoo phenomenon is about victims organizing and speaking their truth when they have been under the trap of systemic and structural deprivation of their rights to being protected by laws - due to a racket of impunity being constructed to shield powerful predators.

@curtztail @Hilliard__ People have moments of weakness - and the #Metoo phenomenon is cognizant of that. Asia and Anthony Bourdain gave money to Jimmy with no demands for secrecy - so far as I have seen in the record. This was an act of altruism. It was not an organized misuse of power. @rosemcgowan

@4d654a348e8842c @Hilliard__ Do these alleged "other photos" indicate any coercion against Jimmy? Do they indicate that Jimmy was being trivialized by agencies that he sought help from? #Metoo is about a system of derailing the interests of people who have been bullied into being abused. @AsiaArgento

@ggbrokensilence @LauriLinnea @4d654a348e8842c @Hilliard__ @AsiaArgento Your report is appreciated Arren J...I hope that it is a sound conclusion to make that Asia was not intimidating Jimmy into unwanted physical coupling. I just hope that it becomes clear that #MeToo is mainly about denial of justice to people who have been misused.

@ThomasARoberts Just going through the reports, it appears that Jimmy did not feel intimidated or coerced in this case, and has asked to be left alone. Those who are suggesting that Asia not be seen as credible have to realize that #MeToo is not about vindictiveness, but is about use of duress.

@charlierose @CharlieRoseShow I hope that you are able to keep your fans apprised of developments, Charlie. I have been communicating with some of the key people associated with the #Metoo phenomenon, and I sense there is a growing interest in healing and rapprochement between people.

For the #MeToo cultural shift to take hold, other kinds of structural dehumanization, and systemic impunity for predators ought to be treated the same way as sexual misconduct. There has to be a critical mass of understanding in society that all this has to go. #PeoplePowerRising
How Saying #MeToo Changed Their Lives https://t.co/GbNY3aBGMb From Jodi Kantor

@CMargaronis @RonanFarrow I agree with your tweet...when the winds change like this, it begins a cultural shift. Ronan, Jodi Cantor and Megan Twohey began a revolution 11 months ago...now it is time for others who know of fields where abuse is rampant to join #Metoo

@RonanFarrow I suspect that Les's  allies will be trying to belittle the results of your investigations, Ronan...so I hope that the sooner #MeToo finds a way to include all groups who have suffered under systemic abuse and impunity for the attackers, the sooner the wider public will get it.

@FredOneonine Thanks for retweeting my post on the "Institutional Betrayal" literature from @jjforegon Professor Freyd. I'm  researching how to get a synchronization between #MeToo and what's happening to banking and investment clients who are confronted with deceptive dealing.

@Variety #MeToo has the potential to be  effective in eradicating the impunity culture that rationalizes doing nothing re systemic abuse. If it begins to widen the circle to all sectors where power is used to deny rule of law. This is where Goal 16 of the 17 SDGs for 2030 is useful.

Thanks Prof Freyd! @profwolff @NaomiAKlein @cathmckenna @ElizabethMay @harrietheywood @Lauren_Steiner @MaraCohen15 #TimesUp #MeToo #PeoplePowerRising @TheLeap_Org  I am so glad that you are helping to bring conscious understanding into society on this subject.
